surface_name: Google Calendar app, Make an API call
title: Google Calendar 'Make an API call' returns 404 when the calendar id is URL-encoded
symptoms: The same request works outside Make
cause: The module encodes the URL itself, so an already-encoded @ (%40) is encoded a second time.
fix: Write the calendar id with a raw @ in the path. Debug errors like this in a throwaway scenario with no error handler, because an Ignore handler hides the message.
